limitations: No new Agent, browser, API or database run; only demand arithmetic replayed.
Job-level seniority labels and frozen requirement mappings are reused, not semantically revalidated.
Three saved AI runs are the same resume, not three independent resumes.
Existing extraction uncertainty and errors are retained. These are sensitivity examples, not accuracy claims.
Match excludes pending and zero-demand skills; changes are not hiring-probability changes.
Unknown and multiple-level jobs are excluded; entry-only AI=8 and DA=2 are very small samples.
Default package replay uses saved aggregate counts, not raw job analyses. Optional source replay needs a separately supplied archive.
Only anonymous numeric score fields are packaged; original resumes, model responses, source paths and job IDs remain local.
Packaging and arithmetic checks do not rerun Agents or establish semantic accuracy.
